name: Opening a Presentation
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on opening a presentation -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Good morning everyone, thanks for being here.
Today I'll be walking you through our Q3 results.
By the end of this presentation, you'll have a clear picture of our next steps.
Feel free to hold questions until the end, or jump in anytime.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
